_provenance: Machine-readable per-scene_case quota single source of truth for the set-maker worklist planner. The eval block is derived from data/eval/real/draw-tracker.md (128 scenes, 32 per equation_kind, stratified across scene_cases). The three structure-only cases (bare_digits, standalone_bar, standalone_bracket) are not in the draw-tracker; small dedicated quotas are added here per the plan because the model must still produce correct row/col/fine_label for them. The train block is a provisional per-case collection target; the gap-driven planner allocates a per-round budget across cases proportional to weakness (read from reports/eval/history.jsonl) with a per-case floor and the value below acting as the per-case cap. draw-tracker.md is a human-readable view derived from this file; the planner never parses markdown.

eval._note: Equation-kind blocks total 32 each (addition / subtraction / multiplication / division) exactly matching draw-tracker.md stratification. Structure-only cases (bare_digits, standalone_bar, standalone_bracket) carry a small dedicated quota. bare_digit_grid is a multi-row/col clean digit grid (ood_unknown) added to cover the row/col-clustering gap single-row bare_digits cannot exercise; it carries a small dedicated quota too. error_cases is a per-equation-kind quota for deliberately-wrong scenes (human draws equation WITH a mistake and tags the error_kind); these are served with directive='error' and require a non-null error_kind on save. 4 per operation kind = 16 total.

train._note: Provisional per-case targets / caps for the gap-driven planner. Base 40 for equation cases; 60 for the cases the draw-tracker flags as weakest (division-short highest priority, division-long, multiplication-multi weakest col placement, subtraction_heavy_borrow, addition_dense_carries); 20 for structure-only cases. error_cases mirrors eval.error_cases but at the larger train scale: deliberately-wrong scenes (human draws the equation WITH a mistake and tags the error_kind) served with directive='error'. These exist because the measured real gap is the operator/equation-kind head (addition eq_kind 0.19, subtraction 0.14); wrong-operator and wrong-carry/borrow scenes are exactly the as-drawn-error supervision that head needs. The planner appends train error items deficit-driven from existing train error sidecars (train GT files carrying an error_kind marker), disjoint seed namespace. 10 per operation kind = 40 total; this acts as the per-kind cap, not a hard floor. division-long is intentionally set to 0 so the gap planner excludes it from the train worklist (a cap <= 0 case is dropped); the other division cases (division-short, division-simple) are unaffected.
